Name: Joja Greenhouse Farm
Author: tikamin557
Description:
Large greenhouse farm by Joja.
Data-wise, it's treated as outside, so lightning rods and scarecrows are a must!

You can select the farm type to be changed in the ModConfig settings.(Default is Hill-top Farm)
